summary: The negation produces a valid arbitrary-rate strict-low sequence with r_n tending to zero. Exact reconstruction, common area normalization, and height reflection put the resulting compatible triangular counterexamples in the stated pinch regime. After fixing one normalized minimal three-halfspace certificate sequence, accepted facts 33f64ca8c4f58f43 and 8261fac79ed77a4f apply to that same sequence and to the identical quantity D_n = 4S_n/3 - sum_i p_{i,n}; row relabeling does not change this sum. Their eventual strict lower and upper bounds contradict each other. The remaining quantifier argument and the unconditional implication with eta_* = 1 are correct.
